description: A digital distortion built on a bistable resonator: audio drives a resonant filter whose feedback path is nonlinear, and which can be pushed into self-oscillation.

params.text: Sets the gain before the resonator, -20dB to 20dB; higher settings give more saturation and push the resonator towards self-oscillation.
Sets the centre frequency of the resonator, 20Hz to 2000Hz.
Sets the damping of the resonator, -6 to -3; more negative settings give a longer, more ringing decay.
Sets the amount of nonlinear distortion in the resonator's feedback path, 0.1 to 1.
Sets the asymmetry of the nonlinearity, -1 to 1, biased towards compression below zero and towards expansion above it.
Sets the level after the resonator, -20dB to 20dB.

inputs.text: The polyphonic audio fed into the resonator.

outputs.text: The resonator output, carrying the same number of channels as the input.

menu: Preset 1 to Preset 4 — each sets the six knobs to a stored combination.
